title: ConceptPsy: A Benchmark Suite with Conceptual Comprehensiveness in Psychology
reasoning: The paper includes an "Ethics Statement" (page 9) but it focuses on ensuring the ethical soundness of the data generation and review process by human annotators. It does not evaluate LLMs' understanding, application, or generation of content related to religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of the benchmark. The benchmark primarily assesses psychology knowledge and reasoning.
